QuestInfo.name: Knowledge is Power
QuestInfo.0: Talk with Feng and approach the temple.
QuestInfo.1:
You ran into Yun Wu at the temple that held all the records of Wu Shen. He attacked you, assuming you were chasing after him. 
There's no reason to avoid the fight. This time, you will emerge victorious!
QuestInfo.2:
You barely pulled out a victory against Yun Wu, thanks to Feng and a monk who defended the temple. Yet even with near-fatal injuries, Yun Wu escaped with the records of Wu Shen. 

The monk said that Wu Shen had one message for his next incarnation, '#eTrust yourself and leave no regrets.#n' 

The monk also offered some information about the techniques of the Devil Clan. Their #edemonic techniques enable one to become strong by coveting what is rightfully another's#n, collecting rage and hatred to fuel the body. That could be what's behind Yun Wu's transformation.
